what_the_project_decided.run5_scope: DEV_ONLY / EXPLORATORY_CONFIRMATION_NOT_INDEPENDENT, 12 fixed subjects, anchor passed, 0 paid / 0 new downloads / 0 SEALED
what_the_project_decided.only_legal_next_step_as_recorded: H8: the author decides the contribution direction; or a new grant for geometry registration / a second library / expansion to 60 subjects
what_the_project_decided.explicitly_forbidden: another reliability variant on the same 12-subject subset

what_survives_and_what_does_not.survives: the negative direction on deployable incremental value of posture prior — no deployable gain over the posture prior on this subset
what_survives_and_what_does_not.does_not_survive: RUN-001's 'significantly worse than the permutation null' strength: the null was a 5-seed ensemble mean while the real arm was a single fit; the fair single-seed audit gives -0.0008 with 30/60 folds worse, i.e. a coin flip

acceptable_probes: A zero-new-fit decomposition over the stored RUN-004 / RUN-005 predictions (e.g. within-key vs inter-frame error variance, or per-subject variance components) — no Run in this project has done it, and 'not predictable beyond magnitude' is precisely the kind of statement that a variance decomposition separates from 'the model is wrong'.
A declared fork: the probe is written, priced, and marked needs_new_authorization because it spends the 60-subject set, the second library or the geometry registration.
A scoped diagnostic on the existing 12 subjects that is genuinely different from RUN-005 (e.g. an identifiability/sensitivity analysis over the stored predictions rather than a new reliability gate).
traps: Proposing a 13th reliability gating variant on the same 12 subjects — the project forbids it in writing.
Proposing a VAL / 60-subject / second-library run without declaring that it needs a new grant.
Asserting that recovery is physically impossible, or that the project failed, from a 12-subject negative.
Treating RUN-001's negative-strength number as evidence — it was judged INVALID for unfair comparison.
grading: Two things are scored: whether the mechanism pair predicts different observations, and whether the probe is inside the grant or explicitly marked as needing one. A probe that only restates the negative scores 0 on discrimination even if it is legal.
